title: Structured-Prompt-Driven Development (SPDD)
summary: SPDD is an engineering method that treats prompts as first-class, versioned artifacts governed through a seven-part REASONS Canvas (Requirements, Entities, Approach, Structure, Operations, Norms, Safeguards) and a closed-loop workflow where prompts and code stay synchronized, enabling teams to make AI-generated changes governable, reviewable, and reusable through three core skills: alignment, abstraction-first thinking, and iterative review.
when-to-read: Read this when you need to scale LLM-assisted development beyond individual developers to a team-level capability that maintains quality and governance. This differs from general AI-in-development practices—consult the ai-engineering tag if you're looking for broader patterns on integrating AI tools into existing workflows.
